absence of unresolved human-review, source-recovery, information-architecture, or external-family gate

recommended_next_batch.name: Municipal Development meeting records: 17 Albuquerque Energy Council records plus the July 10, 2023 GAATC meeting packet
recommended_next_batch.why_next: This is the only currently identified 15-30 unique-record unit with every member already archive-prepared, collision-checked, quality-assessed, source-byte documented, and placed in an established chronological public series. It has high public-information value as primary municipal meeting records and does not require source recovery, human review, new information architecture, or invented family consolidation.
recommended_next_batch.eventual_public_scope: 17 AEC records under Climate Environment, with their recorded City Facilities cross-listing, and one GAATC packet in the Bicycling minutes series. The 18 unique documents are a normal-sized coherent batch; intentional AEC cross-listings do not create additional documents.
remaining_gates: A current user instruction must explicitly authorize the unchanged R2 uploads/storage mutations for these exact 18 originals.
After upload, public archive downloads must be checked against the saved exact byte sizes and SHA-256 values while retaining each official City source URL.

A later, separately authorized public-content stage must implement the exact resolved placements, keep the ten agenda labels and meeting-occurrence caveats intact, run normal site validation, and only then consider a PR or deployment.
